overviewParagraphs: Blue Canyon Country Club is one of the defining golf experiences in Phuket — a course whose canyon layouts, emerald water features, and dramatic finishing holes have made it a must-play destination for visiting golfers for three decades. Multiple Johnnie Walker Classic championships were held here, cementing its reputation as a genuine international stage.

The Canyon Course is the headline offering: a routing through rubber plantation and over water-filled canyons that were created when the land was previously mined. The resulting visual drama is extraordinary, and the strategic demand is equally serious — water threatens approach shots on numerous occasions in the back nine, and the canyon-framed par threes are among the most photographed holes in Asia.

AGS consistently recommends Blue Canyon as the mandatory first round on any Phuket golf trip, setting the tone for the island's premium golf offering and establishing an aesthetic benchmark that all subsequent rounds will be measured against.

In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its canyon chasm 13th & 14th holes (Tiger) and yoshikazu kato tournament routing (Intense shotmaking exam).
